title: Yi Sun-sin
summary: Yi Sun-sin (1545-1598) was a Joseon naval commander, appointed in 1591 to lead Jeolla Province's western fleet. In the Imjin War his fleet won naval battles including Hansan Island in the first invasion and a decisive victory at Myongnyang in the second, hampering Japanese supply routes. He was killed by a stray bullet in 1598; his war diary is on UNESCO's Memory of the World register.

uncertainty.note: Korea.net gives birth on 28 April 1545 without naming the calendar; death is in the last sea battle of the war, 1598.

where.historical_name: Seoul, Joseon Korea (named as his birthplace by Korea.net)

importance.justification: Korea's best-known naval commander, credited by the sources with blocking Japanese resupply by sea during the Imjin War.
